mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_requests ( id, applicant_id, created_by, department_id, requested_supplier_id, title, reason, desired_delivery_date, note, status, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{applicantId}, #{createdBy}, #{departmentId}, #{requestedSupplierId}, #{title}, #{reason}, #{desiredDeliveryDate}, #{note}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS request_id, request_number, status, title, reason, desired_delivery_date, requested_supplier_id, note, version, created_at, updated_at FROM purchase_requests WHERE id = #{requestId} AND applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_requests SET request_number = #{requestNumber}, submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, department_id = #{departmentId}, department_name_snapshot = #{departmentNameSnapshot}, requested_supplier_id = #{requestedSupplierId}, requested_supplier_name_snapshot = #{requestedSupplierNameSnapshot}, title = #{title}, reason = #{reason}, desired_delivery_date = #{desiredDeliveryDate}, note = #{note}, status = 'SUBMITTED', version = version + 1, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_at = #{submittedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND applicant_id = #{applicantId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, version FROM purchase_requests WHERE id = #{requestId} AND applicant_id = #{applicantId}
